description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to party, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Aranea)], [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Aranea)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Aranea)], removes [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Aranea)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Aranea)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [100% Critical 3]/[100% Critical 3], [Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3], and [Quick Cast 3] to all allies if 0-3/4+ XV allies are alive after using a Lightning ability (max 1)

description.name: Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3
description.text: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark and Poison abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
